form.label: AI Workload Infrastructure
form.description: AI Support Bot end to end: customers ask the bot on support.coolashaker.com, Cisco AI Defense inspects every prompt, the LLM answers from the GPU cluster in the Frankfurt DC. If the bot cannot help, the customer calls the Support Hotline.

html.p: Read from left to right: network to DC Frankfurt → AI Support Bot → Cisco AI Defense → GPUs in Frankfurt → Support Hotline. The first red box from the left is closest to the cause.

search.query: index=demo_thousendeyes thousandeyes.test.type=agent-to-agent thousandeyes.target.agent.location=frankfurt | eval loss='metric_name:network.loss' | stats avg(loss) as loss | eval loss=round(loss, 1)
index=demo_thousendeyes "thousandeyes.test.name"="AI Support Assistant API" | eval duration='metric_name:api.duration' | stats avg(duration) as duration | eval duration=round(duration, 1)

index=demo_ai_defense sourcetype="cisco:ai:defense" | stats count(eval(event_message_type="prompt" AND event_action="Allow")) as prompts count(eval(event_message_type="response")) as responses | eval unanswered=round(100 * (prompts - responses) / prompts, 1) | fields unanswered
| mstats avg(_value) as aborted WHERE index=demo_vmware_metrics metric_name="vmware.vm.gpu.llm.requests.aborted.pct" location="frankfurt" | eval aborted=round(aborted, 0)
index=demo_msteams event_type=call_queue_stats queue_name="Support Hotline" | stats latest(calls_waiting) as waiting

panel.title: 1 · Loss to DC Frankfurt by plant (ThousandEyes)

search.query: index=demo_thousendeyes thousandeyes.test.type=agent-to-agent thousandeyes.target.agent.location=frankfurt | eval loss='metric_name:network.loss' | timechart span=1m avg(loss) by thousandeyes.agent.location

panel.title: 2 · AI Support Bot response time by plant (ThousandEyes)

search.query: index=demo_thousendeyes "thousandeyes.test.name"="AI Support Assistant API" | eval duration='metric_name:api.duration' | timechart span=1m avg(duration) by thousandeyes.agent.location

panel.title: 3 · Cisco AI Defense: prompts vs. responses

search.query: index=demo_ai_defense sourcetype="cisco:ai:defense" | eval message=if(event_message_type="prompt", "Prompts", "Responses") | timechart span=1m count by message

index=demo_ai_defense sourcetype="cisco:ai:defense" "event_policy_guardrail_assocs{}.policy_guardrail_assoc.guardrail_avail_entity.guardrail_entity_name"=* | rename "event_policy_guardrail_assocs{}.policy_guardrail_assoc.guardrail_avail_entity.guardrail_entity_name" as Guardrail | stats count as Hits by Guardrail event_action event_message_type | rename event_action as Action event_message_type as Direction | sort - Hits

panel.title: 4 · GPUs Frankfurt: busy, but answers do not arrive

search.query: | mstats avg(_value) as value WHERE index=demo_vmware_metrics location="frankfurt" metric_name IN ("vmware.vm.gpu.utilization.pct", "vmware.vm.gpu.llm.requests.aborted.pct") BY metric_name span=1m | eval metric=case(metric_name="vmware.vm.gpu.utilization.pct", "GPU utilization %", true(), "Aborted requests %") | timechart span=1m avg(value) by metric
index=demo_msteams event_type=call_queue_stats queue_name="Support Hotline" | timechart span=1m max(calls_waiting) as "Calls waiting" sum(bot_handoffs) as "Handed over by the bot"
